meta.alignment: non-uniform windowed local time-warp; analysis in Vicon-theta (C1)

task1_phase_locks.note: excess over per-anchor median residual, per 30deg sector (angle-periodic, C1-safe)

radius_scaling.note: skew amplitude should scale with tangential speed ~ radius at fixed omega

systematic_validation.reading: global k*drdt removes ~0% of angle-periodic variance => systematic is NOT a residual timing/alignment artifact; it is genuine orientation+position-multipath structure (inseparable on RotoArm, C1/prompt 3.2)

static_crosscheck.note: RotoArm theta sets BOTH orientation and position (inseparable); ptp includes phase-center lever-arm + position-multipath, NOT pure orientation

constant_term.note: interaction = residual after removing additive d_tag+d_anchor from absolute c0; nonzero => tag x anchor coupling the additive delay model cannot absorb

task5_radius.method: per-epoch trilateration with current firmware delays (range_mm); NOT fed to any solver (C4); Vicon radius is ground truth

task_C1_sensitivity.note: ±1 Vicon frame (±8.3ms) global alignment perturbation on R01/R08/R14 subset
